# Ultra-Realistic Cassette Deck

> A browser cassette deck simulator. You load your own audio files; they are laid
> onto a cassette as a mixtape and played on a 3D model of a generic 1980s
> silver front-loading deck. It is a static web page with no server, no account
> and no tracking; audio never leaves the device.

URL: https://gitguy268-ultra-realistic-cassette-deck.vercel.app/
Source: https://github.com/Gitguy268/ultra-realistic-cassette-deck
License: MIT

## What it does

- Lays the queue onto C46, C60, C90 or C120 cassettes: side A, then side B, with
  gaps between tracks, and further cassettes when one is full.
- Models the tape transport: a capstan at 4.76 cm/s with a pitch control of plus
  or minus 3 percent, fast wind that speeds up as the take-up pack grows, a
  mechanical counter that counts reel turns, clear leader at both ends, and
  auto-reverse (one side, both sides, or endless).
- Cue and review: holding fast forward or rewind during play runs the tape at
  seven times speed with the head on it. Music search winds to the gap before
  the next or previous track.
- Plays through a tape chain in an AudioWorklet: noise reduction modelled as a
  sliding-band compander (B, or C in two stages), tape hiss by tape type,
  playback equalisation at 120 or 70 microseconds (a mismatch is heard), head
  bump, treble saturation, dropouts at fixed places on the tape, azimuth error on
  the reverse side, and wow and flutter.
- Draws the deck in WebGL: piano keys, a damped door, the cassette with its
  reels turning and its packs growing and shrinking, needle VU meters, the
  counter, slide switches and an output knob. A 2D deck stands in without WebGL.
- Keeps a library and a queue in IndexedDB, with tags, cover art, shuffle and
  repeat. Has a Winamp-style ten-band graphic EQ and a visualizer on the
  cassette's label.
- Works offline after the first visit and can be installed as an app.

## What it does not do

- It does not record. It does not stream music from any service and ships with
  no audio. It does not upload, analyse or share files.
- It is not a measurement-grade emulation. The noise reduction is modelled from
  published descriptions, not from any licensed circuit, and the deck is not a
  copy of any real model. It is not affiliated with any maker.

## Controls

Space plays or pauses; X stops (press again to eject). [ and ] rewind and fast
forward, and cue or review while held during play. B and N search for the
previous or next track. V reverses, E ejects, P switches the power, 0 resets the
counter. Left and right arrows jump five seconds; up and down change the level.
S toggles shuffle, R cycles repeat, F toggles focus mode, and ? lists every
shortcut.
